model_cards.input_schema_summary: Per path per step: (log(S_t / strike), fraction of time-to-maturity remaining in [0, 1], previous holding in [-1, 1]), each a float32 scalar. Output: a tanh-bounded target holding in [-1, 1].
model_cards.intended_use: Research demonstration of CVaR-based deep hedging (Buehler et al. 2019) on synthetic single-asset European-option GBM paths. Not calibrated to, or validated against, real market data.
model_cards.metric_uncertainty_note: Metrics are unweighted means of per-seed estimates, not pooled CVaR. The evaluation section reports paired percentile intervals per seed. Only one policy was trained; these intervals do not cover retraining variability.
model_cards.model_type: Feedforward MLP hedging policy (3 inputs, 2 hidden layers of 32 units, tanh-bounded scalar output)
model_cards.prohibited_use: Any live trading, order routing, or real-money hedging decision. Any use outside the single-asset European vanilla call/put GBM setting it was trained on (not evaluated under Heston, jumps, multiple assets, or real market microstructure).
model_cards.training_data_summary: 2000 synthetic GBM paths (prometheus.stochastica.gbm), physical-measure, seed=1; no empirical/historical data. Policy seed=0.
